headline: What Is Northern Trust (NTRS) Revealing With Its New Real Time Banking APIs?
summary: Northern Trust (NasdaqGS:NTRS) has launched real time banking APIs for institutional clients, integrating account data and payment capabilities into client workflows. NAV Fund Services is the first client to move these APIs into production, using them to connect fund administration operations directly to Northern Trust. The rollout is aimed at improving operational efficiency, data accessibility and risk management for institutional users of Northern Trust's banking platform. For investors...

headline: Is Northern Trust (NTRS) Fully Valued Following Its GPSSA Mandate Renewal And New APIs?
summary: Northern Trust (NTRS) is back in focus after the General Pension and Social Security Authority renewed its long standing mandate and the bank rolled out real time APIs for institutional banking clients. See our latest analysis for Northern Trust. These client wins and new APIs have arrived during a strong run in Northern Trust’s stock, with a 32.38% year to date share price return and a 50.05% total shareholder return over one year. This suggests building momentum as investors reassess growth...
